name: Disease-Produced Molecule With Causal Genetic Evidence
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The disease produces the molecular gene product The pinned descendant closure is biolink:produces.; Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to.; The gene has independent genetic association evidence for the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp.
hypothesis: Independent genetic support tests whether a disease-produced molecule is implicated beyond being a textual biomarker or consequence.

edges.subject: disease
edges.explanation: The disease produces the molecular gene product The pinned descendant closure is biolink:produces.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.
edges.exclusion_rationale: This arm tests the exact stated relation; response, adverse, treatment, and other more-specific assertions would change its biological meaning.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The gene has independent genetic association evidence for the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp.

derived_features.name: complete curated causal drug-target access path
derived_features.definition: A stored Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationship exists for a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure with ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral primary-source support.
inputs: The full pinned affects descendant closure on Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges
derived_features.construction: Filter raw edges by causes qualification and any of the three sources, group by canonical endpoint pair, count distinct raw relationship identities, and merge one compact relationship per pair. Missing qualifiers or source arrays do not qualify. The rule uses only presence, then rematches raw edges with its recorded exact predicates, qualifiers, and sources. Removing the initial access-path MATCH and WITH before the marked comment gives the otherwise identical unmaterialized query.
derived_features.formula: compact presence iff count(distinct qualifying raw relationship)>0
derived_features.interpretation: This is a query acceleration, not a prediction threshold or an extra biological condition. Full-closure and exact-filtered target rules both rematch their own raw evidence. No training or held-out treatment labels define the access path.

mechanism.rationale: Independent genetic support tests whether a disease-produced molecule is implicated beyond being a textual biomarker or consequence. Association does not establish a corrective clinical mechanism.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[compact:MINER_R0004_CURATED_TARGET]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE compact.artifact_id='r0004-curated-causal-target-v1' WITH DISTINCT chemical,gene /* END CURATED ACCESS PATH */ MATCH (disease:Disease)-[production:{{relationship_types:production}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE production.predicate IN {{predicates:production}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[genetic:{{relationship_types:genetic}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE genetic.predicate IN {{predicates:genetic}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(genetic.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; genetic: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
